errors.text_span: което е почти двойно повече от следващия по височина стълб — 2005 г.
errors.evidence: The prompt explicitly forbids making comparisons between values. The description makes a comparison between the value in 2007 and 2005. Furthermore, the comparison is mathematically incorrect; the value for 2007 (approx. 10,000) is almost triple the value for 2005 (approx. 3,500), not 'almost double'.
The bar for 2021 is closer to 900 million BGN, as it is nearly halfway to the 2,000 mark. 800 million BGN is a slight underestimate.
